title: A variable holding a measure value keeps it inside CALCULATE with another filter
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", VAR Total = [Sales Amount] RETURN CALCULATE ( Total, Product[Color] = "Blue" ) )

source.quote: Its value has already been computed and it does not change depending on the filter context.
source.supports: a variable referenced inside CALCULATE is not recomputed under the new filter

source.quote: After DAX calculates the values for a variable expression, those values don't change, even if you reference the variable in another expression.
source.supports: the value of a variable does not change when it is referenced under another context

derivation: Total is defined with no filter: [Sales Amount] = 100 + 40 + 20 + 50 + 200 + 30 + 100 = 540. CALCULATE adds Color = Blue but Total is already a value, so the result is 540, not the Blue amount 80. SUM of a fixed decimal column is a fixed decimal.
